decisions.story_title: Unit 42: AgtaBackup RAT delivered via fake videoconferencing pages and RMM enrollment
decisions.reason: Primary reporting: Unit 42's timely-threat-intel post (author Ofek Lahiani) documents a previously-undocumented multi-stage campaign delivering a .NET 8 AgtaBackup RAT via a fake videoconferencing Microsoft Store page, attacker-enrolled legit RMM tools (LogMeIn Resolve, ScreenConnect), keylogging, UAC bypass, browser credential theft across nine browsers, and 40+ C2 domains.
